_comment: Copy this file to jobsearch.config.json and edit it. Every field is optional - anything you leave out is simply not applied. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

search._comment: The searches the server runs when you call search_jobs with no query.
search._comment_local: Optional second lane for roles you could commute to. Leave local_metro empty if you only want remote roles.

filters._comment: Optional noise control for broad queries. Leave the lists empty and nothing is filtered.
filters._comment_ic: Set to true only if you are specifically looking for roles with leadership scope.

deal_breakers._comment: Hard rules checked by check_deal_breakers. salary_floor of 0 disables the salary check.
